name: Four disciplines contained in one system
useWhen: Four capabilities that live INSIDE one system rather than beside each other, with prose to land the claim.

focal.note: The hub disc, measured as diameter. It is the only orange fill and the largest single object; that is what makes it read as the centre rather than a fifth node.

replacesNote: orbit-v1 draws thin outline rings around a navy hub and carries a headline and one line. Keep both: v1 for a light touch, this when the containment claim is the point and there is prose to support it.

deviations.what: curved text and halftone wordmark on the outer ring
deviations.why: Bespoke artwork, not system elements. A curved text run is not something the kit can express, and teaching it to would licence per-slide typography.
